ModMetadata.Name: Inventory Peek
ModMetadata.Author: XCeled
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Keep your inventory open without it in the way[/h1] Mark the inventory windows you use most as hidable. They disappear while you play and come back the instant you hold [b]Alt[/b] to use the cursor, exactly where you left them. Leave everything open and still see the world.
[hr][/hr] [h2]How it works[/h2] [list] [*]Every inventory window gets an [b]eye[/b] button on its title bar. Click it to make that window hidable; click it again to keep it always visible. [*]While the cursor is locked (normal play) a hidable window is invisible and clicks pass straight through it. [*]Hold [b]Alt[/b] (the mouse-control key), or open any screen that frees the cursor, and every hidden window shows at once, ready to use. [*]The choice is per window: hiding your backpack's window does not hide another backpack's. It is remembered across sessions. [*]A drag that starts while the cursor is free keeps the window up until you let go. [/list]
[hr][/hr] [h2]What it does not change[/h2] The windows stay open, docked or undocked, exactly as the game has them. Nothing is closed, moved or re-sorted, and slot hotkeys, sort, dock and close all work as usual. A hidden docked window keeps its place in the dock.
The game's own [b]`[/b] key is different: it closes every window, and you reopen each one by hand.
Client side only: nothing is sent over the network, so it is safe in multiplayer.
[hr][/hr] [h2]Settings[/h2] In the mod's config ([i]net.xceled.stationeers.inventorypeek.cfg[/i]): [table] [tr][th]Setting[/th][th]Default[/th][th]What it does[/th][/tr] [tr][td]Enabled[/td][td]on[/td][td]Off shows every window as the game does.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]HiddenOpacity[/td][td]0[/td][td]How visible a hidden window stays: 0 is invisible, 0.2 leaves a faint outline.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]ToggleKey[/td][td]none[/td][td]Optional key that toggles the window under the cursor while Alt is held, instead of the eye.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]HidableWindows[/td][td]empty[/td][td]The windows you have marked. The eye button keeps it up to date.[/td][/tr] [/table]
[hr][/hr] You need [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] for this mod to work.
Source code: [url=https://github.com/altmank/Stationeers-InventoryPeek]github.com/altmank/Stationeers-InventoryPeek[/url]
